defect.head: 82fd1ac39e9986b7ae89fb0bd84c38a3d4c79895
defect.cause: Producer returns a closed exact owner registry or CoinPaprika reference, but external capability method allowlist accepted only three other methods.

repair: Common typed identity validator carries CLOSED owner registry or exact CoinPaprika reference receipts while preserving producer method.
Collector validates original address, chain and instrument on each external venue; a method label alone never qualifies.
Retained binding proof is rechecked by Bitget/KuCoin N12 normalizer and consumer validator; no changed-address proof reuse.
No extra shared HTTP allowance, no score, no independent vote created by static identity metadata.

saved_replay.activity_ticker_only: Controlled positive activity fixture; qualified flow uses original source candles.
